notes.title: v0.5.0 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[list][*]EXTRA mode has been officially added! The game will let you know how to unlock EXTRA mode, once you achieve an A rank or higher on every stage.
[*] Bug fixes[/list]

[*] Other minor bug fixes[/list]

notes.title: v0.3.6 Patch Note
notes.notes: Fixed a memory leak issue that occurred in the stage selection screen.

notes.title: v0.3.5 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[list][*] Improved key binding convenience. The game will now accept almost any key combination.
[*] Fixed an issue where the game language would be fixed to English in environments such as SteamOS. The game now preferentially detects the user's Steam interface language.[/list]

notes.title: v0.3.4 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[list][*] While playing the 'Net' stage, you will now be given a bit of extra time even if you take all your fingers off the keyboard; so the stage will not be immediately failed.
[*] The ranking criteria for the 'Warm-Up' and 'Round Trip' stages have been adjusted.[/list]

notes.title: v0.3.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[list][*] You can now resize the window when the game is in windowed mode. (Switch to window mode with Alt+Enter)
[*] The patterns in the stage 'Chaos' are no longer random.[/list]

notes.title: Fingerdance Now Available on Steam
notes.notes:
[b]'Fingerdance'[/b] is now available on Steam. Developed by zniq, test your dexterity in this "finger-twister" game.

Place five fingers of any hand comfortably on your keyboard. You have to press and release each finger according to the given patterns. It’s a bit like a rhythm game—but there’s no need to match the beats precisely. Take your time!

The faster you complete each pattern, the higher your rank will be. Try getting an S-rank on every stage!

We're holding a 10% launch discount, so get it now and have some fun!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3633450
